h1: Intelligent Cloud Agents Powering Papua New Guinea
sub: Deploy personal AI agents in dedicated cloud computers that manage browser tasks, code, and app integrations 24/7—even when your phone is offline.
audience: Papua New Guinea agribusiness exporters, mining suppliers, Port Moresby commercial firms, Lae logistics managers, and remote technical teams.
manifesto: When remote geography and unpredictable bandwidth challenge operations, Ceyo works uninterrupted in secure cloud environments—executing market analysis, syncing inventories, and coding continuously whether your local connection is active or completely offline.

uses.d: Your agent browses international commodity boards daily, comparing spot prices for Arabica coffee and cocoa to alert Goroka and Kokopo producers via Telegram.
Bots monitor shipping schedules, extract consignments from incoming manifests, and automatically update shared Google Sheets for freight forwarders at Port of Lae.
An autonomous browser agent checks procurement portals across PNG resource corridors, collating tender notices and formatting proposals directly into your CRM.
Field supervisors connect remote project teams in Telegram groups, where specialized bots parse daily site progress, fuel consumption, and safety reports.
The built-in coding agent builds, tests, and serves internal web dashboards inside its dedicated cloud environment without requiring local server setups.
Connect over 1,000 software tools to match supplier purchase orders with bank records, scheduling weekly financial summaries across Gmail and Notion.

steps.d: Select your tier, activate your 3-day free trial, and initialize your personal bot's dedicated cloud computer.
Link your Telegram, Google Workspace, Notion, or internal apps and assign browser or coding tasks.
Schedule autonomous daily workflows that run 24/7 in the cloud, even when your phone or PC is switched off.

chapters.d: Before traffic stirs on Hubert Murray Highway, your agent has already scanned regional trade updates and assembled a concise morning briefing on Telegram. Critical shipping and exchange rates are logged into your dashboard without you lifting a finger.

While your team handles warehouse logistics, your Ceyo browser agent navigates supplier catalogues to cross-reference equipment prices across international distributors. It compiles a clean comparison table complete with freight estimates and specs.

Your coding agent writes and tests a custom data ingestion script in its isolated cloud sandbox, connecting raw field metrics into a customer portal. It verifies the endpoints autonomously and alerts you when deployment succeeds.

Even after you disconnect from the mobile network for the evening, your cloud computer keeps running scheduled monitoring routines. It guards your data feeds, audits documents, and prepares tomorrow's operational schedule.

faq.q: What are the subscription plans and trial terms for Ceyo?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial granting up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked card is billed only when the trial concludes unless cancelled prior.

faq.q: Does my Ceyo bot keep working if my phone loses internet in PNG?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo agent lives in its own dedicated cloud computer independent of your device. It performs automated web tasks, executes code, and runs scheduled routines 24/7 even during local connectivity cuts or power outages.

faq.q: Can I manage my AI agents directly through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can interact with your agents one-on-one via personal Telegram bots or invite multiple specialized Ceyo bots into Telegram group chats where they collaborate alongside your team.

faq.q: What languages and tools can Ceyo agents handle?
faq.a: Ceyo agents communicate smoothly in English and hundreds of other world languages. They also connect with over 1,000 apps including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, and standard CRMs, and feature a built-in crypto wallet.

faq.q: How does the coding agent work?
faq.a: The coding agent operates directly inside the cloud computer, where it writes, runs, and debugs code in real time. It can build websites, process data files, and test web applications safely within its isolated sandbox.
